text: In the category Ring, the inclusion ℤ ↪ ℚ is:
choices: an epimorphism that is not surjective
a monomorphism that is not injective
neither a monomorphism nor an epimorphism
explanation: Two ring maps out of ℚ agreeing on ℤ must agree everywhere, since φ(1/n) is forced to be φ(n)⁻¹ — so ℤ ↪ ℚ is right-cancellable (epi) despite missing most of ℚ. This is the standard warning that 'epi' need not mean 'surjective' outside Set-like categories.
